type V1CatalogDefinition = Readonly<{ id: string; types: readonly string[] }>;
type MissionStepActionType = 'start' | 'pause';
type MissionStepStatus = 'ready' | 'active';
type MissionStepType = 'tap' | 'drag';

const catalog = {
  id: 'technical-record-id',
  types: ['tap', 'drag'],
} satisfies V1CatalogDefinition;

const action = 'start' satisfies MissionStepActionType;
const status = 'ready' satisfies MissionStepStatus;
const stepType = 'tap' satisfies MissionStepType;

const finding = diagnostic('Developer-only validation diagnostic.');

void catalog;
void action;
void status;
void stepType;
void finding;
